{{Quote|We'll eat ''bas neral'' if we have to.|[[Neth Bralor]]|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
'''''Bas neral''''' was a coarse [[Grain/Legends|grain]].<ref name="Mando'a" /> Grown on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] by a number of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]],<ref name="Revelation" /> ''bas neral'' was commonly used for [[Alcohol/Legends|brewing]] and as [[Foodstuff/Legends|feed]] for animals. Though ''bas neral'' was widely considered by most Mandalorians to be unfit for [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] to consume,<ref name="Mando'a" /> the grain nevertheless could be eaten if circumstances necessitated such a decision.<ref name="Revelation" /> ''[[Vhe'viin]]e'', small [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Mandalore, had a taste for the Mandalorian grain, frequently pilfering the stockpiles of local [[Farm/Legends|farms]].<ref name="Revelation" />

In Mandalorian society, the phrase "sowed his ''bas neral''" took on the colloquially informal meaning of having had [[Youngling/Legends|children]].<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Bas neral'' was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe via a mention in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel, [[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice|''Sacrifice'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[May 29]], [[2007]].<ref name="Sacrifice" /> It was later mentioned again in Traviss' follow-up novel, [[Legacy of the Force: Revelation|''Revelation'']], published the following year on [[February 26]], [[2008]].<ref name="Revelation" /> Later that year, ''bas neral'' was again mentioned in the fourth entry of Traviss' [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] of novels, entitled [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], released on [[September 16]].<ref name="O66" /> ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December 20]], [[2011]], made further mention of ''bas neral''.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
